cohort: The study included 702 women in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, who were either currently pregnant or had been pregnant before.
finding: Awareness of chorioamnionitis was moderate among women in Makkah, with education, income, and previous pregnancy complications significantly influencing knowledge levels.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly more common among women with a history of chorioamnionitis compared to those without.
cross-section timing: Among women who were either currently pregnant or had been pregnant before.
